item.title: Census 2026 - Forms Still Open
item.description: Census night was Tuesday 11 August. The ABS is still accepting household forms. Not completing the census risks a fine.

item.title: Thanks for Joining Ask Us Anything
item.description: Thanks to everyone who came to Ask Us Anything on Wednesday and sent questions via Menti. Lewis and Craig worked through a good number of sharp questions.

item.title: Board Meeting - FY26 Business Plan Wrapped Up
item.description: The Board met Thursday 13 August and congratulated all teams on successfully completing the FY26 Business Plan. Well done everyone.

item.title: Board Approvals - August Meeting
item.description: The Board approved: delegations register updates, the FY26 annual crediting rate for working subcontractors, FY27 risk appetite, PI9 scope and budget, and three policies.

item.title: PI9 Delivery Now Underway
item.description: The focus stays where we left it at playback: a working product by the end of the increment, and teams working as one to achieve it.

item.description: The Leaders Meeting is on Wednesday 19 August.

item.title: Blood Bank Leave - Donate Without Loss of Pay
item.description: Under the LeavePlus Enterprise Agreement, staff are released from duty without loss of pay to donate blood once every 12 weeks. Blood, plasma and platelets save lives.

item.description: Interested in presenting the Acknowledgement of Country at a Town Hall? Sign up via the All Staff Announcements channel. Your voice can make the moment meaningful.

item.title: Wellness Corner - Don't Fear Coffee
item.description: Coffee is rich in antioxidants and linked to longevity and lower disease risk. Three to four cups a day looks best. Keep it under four and go easy on the sugar.
